description_sq:
Shiten zyra ne nje nga lokacionet me te preferuara per zhvillimin e bizneseve, ne qender prane Hotel Plaza, me siperfaqe totale 99 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 89 m2.
Zyrat ndodhen ne katin e pare teknik te nje pallati te ri. Jane te mireorganizuara dhe me shikueshmeri ne ne rrugen kryesore.
Disponojne Certifikate Pronesie.
Mund te perdoren per aktivitete te ndryshme si klinike dentare, zyre avokatie/noterie/kontabiliteti.
Gjithashtu me zyrat shitet dhe nje garazh me siperfaqe 20.3m2 me cmim ekstra 40'000€.
Vendndodhja eshte nder me te kërkuarat pasi ofron facilite te shumta.
title_en: Offices for sale near Hotel Plaza
description_en: Offices for sale in one of the most preferred locations for business development, in the center near Hotel Plaza, with a total area of ​​99 m2 and a net area of ​​89 m2. The offices are located on the technical first floor of a new building. They are well organized and more visible on the main street. They have Ownership Certificates. They can be used for various activities such as dental clinics, law/notary/accounting offices. A garage with an area of ​​20.3m2 is also sold with the offices, with an extra price of €40,000. The location is among the most sought after as it offers many facilities.
